top_10_opportunities.rationale: WordPress REST API /wp-json/ exposes multiple namespaces (wp/v2, yoast/v1, akismet/v1, etc.) + xmlrpc.php enabled. High-value target for authentication bypass, data exposure, or plugin vulnerabilities.
High-traffic site (3.7M visits/month) with full auth surface (/login, /inloggen, /mijn, /account, /auth). User accounts likely contain weather alerts, subscription data.
Drupal platform with auth endpoints (/user/login, /user/password, /admin/). RIVM health data ecosystem — potential PII exposure if authentication bypass exists.
Drupal 10 with auth endpoints. International trade portal — user accounts may contain business data, export documentation.
High-traffic traffic info site (993K visits/month) with auth endpoints. User accounts may contain route preferences, location data.
Job portal (637K visits/month) with auth surface. User accounts contain PII: CV data, job applications, personal info.
Water data platform (507K visits/month) with auth. User accounts may contain water level alerts, location-based subscriptions.
CVD program operator's own site. /api/media/* endpoint for media files. Strict CSP but may have SSRF or path traversal in image API.
Construction damage reporting (129K visits/month) with /login endpoint. Claims data, construction site details, witness PII at risk.
Customs (Douane) portal with auth endpoints. High sensitivity: import/export data, customs declarations, business PII.
